svg.title: SOLID ports-and-adapters architecture for Company Analytics
svg.desc: Host-native harness adapters call portable application services. Implemented provider-neutral public research-data adapters and future licensed adapters normalize through SourcePort, while the pinned upstream executor remains a CI and development oracle until removal gates pass. Completed projections feed read-only clients.
